command: with old as (select * from knowledge_snapshots where state='APPROVED' limit 1), changed as (update knowledge_snapshots s set state='SUPERSEDED' from old where s.owner_profile_id=old.owner_profile_id and s.id=old.id returning s.owner_profile_id,s.id) insert into knowledge_snapshots(owner_profile_id,id,version,state,session_row_version,canonical_digest,source_revision_digests,profile_revision_digests,item_bindings,conflict_decisions,gaps,approved_by,approved_at,created_at) select old.owner_profile_id,'019f0000-0000-7000-8000-000000000012'::uuid,old.version+1,'APPROVED',old.session_row_version+1,'184a2070f5fa466b25603f61bad1e41263f615e04cb45f124523baaf9ee95d50',old.source_revision_digests,old.profile_revision_digests,old.item_bindings,old.conflict_decisions,old.gaps,old.owner_profile_id,now(),now() from old; insert into knowledge_snapshot_source_bindings(owner_profile_id,snapshot_id,source_revision_id,source_digest) select b.owner_profile_id,'019f0000-0000-7000-8000-000000000012'::uuid,b.source_revision_id,b.source_digest from knowledge_snapshot_source_bindings b join knowledge_snapshots s on s.owner_profile_id=b.owner_profile_id and s.id=b.snapshot_id where s.state='SUPERSEDED' order by s.approved_at desc limit 1;
